name: Freely distributed by the Astronomical Data Center
content:
The Bright Star Catalogue, 5th Revised Edition (Preliminary Version)
D. Hoffleit and W. H. Warren Jr., Astronomical Data Center, NSSDC/ADC (1991)
Catalog V/50, as distributed by the CDS, Strasbourg.

The catalog is distributed freely by the Astronomical Data Center and the CDS. Star Chart carries it unchanged, with its own documentation (the catalog's ReadMe) bundled beside it as res/raw/bs_readme, and credits its compilers, Dorrit Hoffleit and Wayne H. Warren Jr.
